usd_reason: Easing Middle East tensions reduce pressure on the US dollar
gold_reason: Gold prices climb as pause in West Asia crisis curbs inflation risk
indices_reason: Easing global tensions and falling oil prices support stock market gains
lead_story: The easing of Middle East tensions is the biggest macro driver right now, with oil prices sliding 5% and Treasury yields tumbling as a result. This reduction in geopolitical risk is supporting stock markets and gold prices. The Federal Reserve is also in focus as interest rates remain under scrutiny.
